name: @openformatdb/mcp
description: MCP server for OpenFormatDB: identify a file, find which open tools read, write and convert its format, and convert it locally with WebAssembly engines

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts src/tools.ts --bundle --splitting --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __ofdbRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __ofdbRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = new URL(import.meta.url).pathname; const __dirname = __filename.slice(0, __filename.lastIndexOf('/'));" --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external:zod --external:yaml --external:ajv --external:ajv-formats && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
